messages:
leah: Heads-up: sudden hailstorm on 9th Ave, sidewalks are skating rinks. Caltrain reported signal interference; trains are moving at walking pace. Anyone switching plans? :cloud_with_snow:
devin: Yikes. Switched to bike+ferry but hail shredded my jacket. Might stay home.
omar: If you need a lift from Inner Sunset, I have room for two. Leaving 7:45. DM. :car:
sophia: I'm bringing spare shoe covers to the office locker — leave a note if you want them. :boot:
team-bot: Caltrain status: Delays 15-30 min between Daly City and SF due to weather. https://caltrain.com/status/9999
leah: Quick poll: :house: = WFH, :taxi: = use car, :bike: = brave it. React!
devin: Photo posted (hail on my car hood). Also, FYI 5th-floor heater is off — maintenance running safety checks after a power blip.
omar: Anyone near 3rd & Folsom need a short lift? I'm looping that way in ~10.
sophia: Also coffee shortage alert espresso machine is down; K-cups in the pantry if you need a fix.
leah: If you grabbed a hat from the communal bin, tag it please. Somebody nabbed my beanie last week :sob:
devin: Cyclist PSA: watch manhole covers and painted crosswalks  they're extra slippery today.
team-bot: Incident log: 1799991234 - Hailstorm reported; facilities and transit teams notified.
sophia: I'll tally the poll in 20 and post desk occupancy to ops. Stay dry everyone!
